scripts.build:user: npm run build && cp capacitor.config.user.ts capacitor.config.ts && npx cap sync
scripts.build:admin: npm run build && cp capacitor.config.admin.ts capacitor.config.ts && npx cap sync
scripts.open:user:android: npm run build:user && npx cap open android
scripts.open:admin:android: npm run build:admin && npx cap open android
scripts.generate:apk:user: npm run build:user && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug && cd ..
scripts.generate:apk:admin: npm run build:admin && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug && cd ..
